name: s3-archiver
changelog:
v4: the settings page follows the person's light or dark theme (D184, <html data-bx-theme="auto">), drawn from the workspace's tokens, fonts and 2px corners; Save & test is the primary button and the status line carries its icon
v3: sealed backups — a sealed archive's backup key (X-XBin-Backup-Subkey) is recorded as a marker (a PUT whose marker fails keeps nothing; a pruned version takes its marker with it), POST /archive/erase deletes every version sealed under erased keys, and a file from a sealed archive answers 422 (xbind extracts it)
v2: a native view for the xbin app (native.js): the settings form (the secret in a secure field) with Save & test and Test connection
v1: archive interface provider backed by S3 (SigV4, path-style)
title: S3 Archiver
description: Stores component backups in an S3 bucket. Bind a component's @archive to it (or make it the workspace default) and backups, scheduled backups, and offload all stream here. Works with AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2 — any S3-compatible endpoint. Credentials live in the tile's vault.
